evidence.section: 3.3. The 3D strain gradient of heterogeneous interface
evidence.quote: The original deformed grains at the positions of strain peaks partly recrystallize, forming the heterogeneous laminated structure in which coarse grains with an average size of 28 μm were enveloped by nano-sized grains.

evidence.section: 4.3. Microscopic mechanism of heterogeneous interface deformation
evidence.quote: The elements Al, Ta, Nb, Hf and Ti diffuse into the diffusion reaction layer from both side of base materials. The larger difference in shear modulus between elements increase the modulus mismatch according to the solid solution strengthening model [54], thereby enhancing the solid solution strengthening effect at interface.
